author: TomiValny
description: In the narrow streets of Jewish quarter of Tetouan... Almost every big historical city in Morocco has its Jewish quarter called Mellah. Here in Tetouan is known by Spanish name Juderia or Qods, or Little Jerusalem. Entrance is very easy to find - as its part of Medina, and close to Royal Palace, from its south - you just turn to the right right before the Bab er-Rouah. Main, central street is Akka
